teaser.en: A wild cousin of the custard apple, its knobbly yellow fruit is one of the best-loved snacks of the coastal bush.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa porini wa mtopetope, tunda lake la manjano lenye vinundu ni mojawapo ya vitafunio vinavyopendwa zaidi katika vichaka vya pwani.

summary.en: *Mbokwe* is the wild custard apple, a small tree of the lowland grassland whose knobbly fruit ripens yellow-orange. It is one of the wild fruits commonly eaten by the Digo, and its wood makes hoe handles.
summary.sw: *Mbokwe* ni mtomoko mwitu, mti mdogo wa nyika za nyanda za chini ambao tunda lake lenye vinundu huiva likawa la manjano-machungwa. Ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini yanayoliwa sana na Wadigo, na mbao zake hutengeneza mipini ya majembe.

about.en: *Mbokwe* is a shrub or small tree up to about 6 m. Its broad leaves are blue-green above and hairy beneath, and they feel thick and leathery. The fruit is round and knobbly, a small version of the custard apple, turning from green to yellow-orange as it ripens.
about.sw: *Mbokwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaofikia urefu wa takriban m 6. Majani yake mapana ni ya kijani-buluu upande wa juu na yenye vinyweleo upande wa chini, na huhisika manene kama ngozi. Tunda lake ni la mviringo lenye vinundu, kama topetope dogo, na hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi manjano-machungwa linapoiva.

where.en: It grows in wet lowland savanna and wooded grassland. Look for the ripening yellow-orange fruit among the blue-green leaves.
where.sw: Huota katika savana za nyanda za chini zenye unyevu na nyika zenye miti. Tafuta matunda yanayoiva ya manjano-machungwa katikati ya majani ya kijani-buluu.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit, with its acid-sweet pulp, is eaten raw and is among the wild fruits Digo people commonly eat. Bark, roots and fruit are used in traditional medicine.

The bark gives a fibre and a brown dye, and the wood is often used for hoe handles.
uses.sw:
Tunda lililoiva, lenye nyama ya uchachu-utamu, huliwa bichi na ni miongoni mwa matunda ya porini yanayoliwa sana na Wadigo. Gome, mizizi na matunda hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji.

Gome hutoa nyuzi na rangi ya kahawia, na mbao zake mara nyingi hutumika kwa mipini ya majembe.

names.en: The Digo name is *mbokwe*; the Mgombato dictionary spells it *m'bokpwe* and gives the Swahili *mtopetope*. Other Swahili names are *mtomoko mwitu* ('wild custard apple') and *mkonokono*. In Giriama it is *mutaioma*. In English it is the wild custard apple or wild soursop.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mbokwe*; kamusi ya Mgombato inaliandika *m'bokpwe* na kutoa jina la Kiswahili *mtopetope*. Majina mengine ya Kiswahili ni *mtomoko mwitu* ('mtomoko wa porini') na *mkonokono*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mutaioma*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *wild custard apple* au *wild soursop*.

reason.en: Same genus, the cultivated custard apple

reason.sw: Mviru (*wild medlar*), tunda jingine la vichakani

reason.en: Sour plum, another wild bush fruit
reason.sw: Mtundukula, tunda jingine la porini la vichakani

mgombato: m'bokpwe (mi) type of fruit tree: wild custard apple, wild soursop (Annona senegalensis) whose wood is often used for hoe handles; mbokwe, mtopetope.
